mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing armodafinil plasma concentrations, while armodafinil may induce CYP3A4 affecting esomeprazole metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil side effects (insomnia, headache, tachycardia); consider alternative PPI or dose adjustment if excessive stimulant effects occur.
